title: Receive opens a modal (no navigation) with contents depending on entry point
preconditions:
1. You are signed in with Order Parts.
2. A work order has parts awaiting receipt, some with a vendor and some vendorless, across lines.
steps:
1. Open Receive from a part row where the part has a vendor.
2. From a part row where the part has no vendor.
3. From a line's menu.
4. From the bulk action bar (or the completion wizard).
expected:
1. Receiving from a part row, a line menu, the bulk bar or the wizard opens a modal - there is no navigation, and it is the same modal in all four cases.
2. Part row, part has a vendor: every part on this work order from that same vendor still awaiting receipt, all ticked.
3. Part row, part has no vendor: every part on this work order with no vendor, none ticked.
4. Line menu: that line's outstanding parts. Bulk bar or wizard: every outstanding part on the work order.
5. The settings never change what the modal contains (Require receiving only decides where Receive lives and whether outstanding parts block invoicing).
6. One card per vendor showing vendor name, part count and total; Vendor missing sorts first.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9259 (Story 13, Receiving from the work order) and the Simple Flow V2 specification version 23, read on 21 August 2026.

title: Receive requires vendor, invoice number and invoice date; cost and tax prefilled
preconditions:
1. You are signed in with Order Parts.
2. The receive modal is open on a vendor card with parts awaiting receipt.
steps:
1. Expand a vendor card and read the required fields and the per-part editable fields.
2. Try to receive with the invoice number blank.
3. Edit a cost and watch for a note.
expected:
1. An expanded card shows vendor invoice number, invoice date and delivery note on one row, then the parts; the invoice date defaults to today and is editable.
2. Vendor, vendor invoice number and invoice date are all required; the modal marks them required and disables its receive button until they are filled, rather than submitting into an error.
3. The delivery note is optional.
4. Editable per part: part number, quantity received and cost (editing a part number into a catalogue part needs Catalog & Inventory: Create & Edit).
5. Cost is required and may be zero, arriving prefilled from the purchase order; tax is required and may be zero, prefilled from the vendor's tax rate (falling back to zero when nothing derives it).
6. Quantity received must be greater than zero, may include decimals, and may exceed what was ordered (the excess is shown but not blocked; the PO absorbs it). Changing cost shows a note that the sell price will update.

---

title: The wizard opens only from defined entry points when something is collectable
preconditions:
1. You are signed in with completion permissions.
2. A work order has lines with outstanding collectable items, and a tidy work order with nothing outstanding.
steps:
1. Trigger Complete on a line, Complete lines / Complete all lines, Create invoice, and Clock out and complete on a work order with outstanding items.
2. Trigger a completion on a tidy work order with nothing outstanding.
expected:
1. The wizard opens from exactly these entry points: Complete on a line; Complete lines; Complete all lines; Create invoice; Clock out and complete - and from nothing else (no timer, no background job, no side effect).
2. It opens only when something required is both outstanding and collectable; if nothing is, the action completes immediately and no wizard appears.
3. Collectable means: a missing tech story, a missing mileage or engine hours reading, an unpicked inventory part, an unresolved core, or an unreceived part.
4. Mark as reviewed never opens the wizard (it only becomes available once every line is complete).
5. The run records which lines it covers and whether it is heading to an invoice, fixed when the run opens.
6. A step the user's role cannot perform is not shown; where that step is the only outstanding work, the action fails with the reason instead of opening an empty wizard.

title: Money follows See Financial Data; work follows View mode
preconditions:

steps:
